name: crossposter
description: Draft, preview, schedule and publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and 5 more social networks.

interface.longDescription:
CrossPoster is a social media publishing workspace. Connected to ChatGPT, it lets you write, review and ship posts for the accounts you have linked in CrossPoster, without leaving the conversation.

Drafts: create a draft for any connected account, read it back, list recent drafts, and search your past posts and drafts by meaning.
Writing: generate new copy sized for the target platforms, or improve, shorten, rephrase or add hashtags to text you give it. Nothing is saved unless you ask for a draft.
X wording: score a post's wording against CrossPoster's model trained on real X posts, aspect by aspect, and get a rewrite that adds no facts, names, links, mentions or hashtags when one scores higher.
Previews: see how a draft will look on its platform, show a connected account, and list your connected platforms as inline cards.
Analytics: summary metrics and recent published posts for X and LinkedIn.
Publishing: publish a draft now or schedule it for later. Publishing requires an explicit confirmation step before anything leaves CrossPoster.

Access is granted per permission when you connect: read, create drafts, generate content, and publish. Everything acts only on the social accounts connected in your CrossPoster workspace; connecting an account happens in CrossPoster, never from chat. A CrossPoster account is required.
capabilities: Preview posts as they will appear
Score and improve X post wording
defaultPrompt: List my recent CrossPoster drafts and show how the newest will look.
Write a short LinkedIn post announcing our new feature and save it as a draft.
Score the wording of this X post and suggest a better version.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the drafts in the reviewer workspace with their platform and a short text excerpt.

positive.prompt: Show how my newest CrossPoster draft will look on its platform.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest draft and renders an inline preview card of it as the platform will show it.

positive.prompt: Write a short LinkedIn post announcing that we now support scheduling, and save it as a draft in CrossPoster.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the post, saves it as a LinkedIn draft and returns a link to open it in CrossPoster; the new draft then appears in list_drafts.

positive.prompt: Score the wording of this X post and rewrite it if you can do better: "We just shipped scheduling for Bluesky. Try it today and tell us what you think."
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a score for each wording aspect, and either a rewrite that scores higher and adds no facts, names, links, mentions or hashtags, or a statement that no candidate rewrite beat the original.

positive.prompt: Which social accounts are connected to my CrossPoster workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected Bluesky test account and renders it as an inline account card.

negative.description: General writing that is not a social post
Reading social feeds, which CrossPoster does not do
negative.prompt: What's trending on X right now?

negative.description: Scheduling a meeting rather than a post
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team for Friday at 3pm.

review.commerce_description: CrossPoster sells nothing through ChatGPT; plans are managed on crossposter.tech.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: drafts, previews, writing tools, X wording scores, analytics for X and LinkedIn, and confirmed publishing and scheduling.
